title: The technical and maintenance infrastructure and the fighter-jet staging areas of the enemy at the two US air bases, King Hussein and Al-Azraq, were pounded.
text:
The technical and maintenance infrastructure and the fighter-jet staging areas of the enemy at the two US air bases, King Hussein and Al-Azraq, were pounded."

"Public Relations Department of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps:"

"In the name of God, the Breaker of the tyrants"
""Whoever commits aggression against you, respond in kind to the aggression committed against you""

"To the noble and resurgent people of Islamic Iran,"
"One hundred and eighty-three nights of your epic, uninterrupted, and historic presence on the scene have left the enemy bewildered and stunned, bringing hope to the oppressed and delight to the eyes of the warriors of Islam."

"Minutes ago, the brave warriors of the IRGC Aerospace Force, in response to the US-Zionist aerial aggression against Lark Island, in the operation to punish the aggressor, carried out a combined missile-and-drone operation under the code name "O Muhammad ibn Abdullah (PBUH)," striking with ballistic missiles the technical and maintenance infrastructure and the fighter-jet staging areas of the enemy at the two US air bases, King Hussein and Al-Azraq in Jordan, smashing them and inflicting heavy damage upon them."

"The IRGC warns that aggression and criminality will not remedy the enemy's desperation in trying to weaken the Islamic Republic's control over the Strait of Hormuz, and every launch will be met with even more crushing responses."

"And victory comes only from God, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
